lab_questions.title: Maximum Continuous Stock Trading Profit
lab_questions.description:
An algorithmic trading platform evaluates daily profit/loss figures of an asset over N consecutive trading days. Traders want to identify the maximum cumulative profit achievable across any contiguous sequence of trading days.

Read N (number of days), followed by N integers representing daily gain/loss. Output the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray.

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
Input:
8
-2 1 -3 4 -1 2 1 -5
Expected Output: 6

solution.python:
import sys
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
if data:
    n = data[0]
    arr = data[1:n+1]
    max_so_far = arr[0]
    curr_max = arr[0]
    for x in arr[1:]:
        curr_max = max(x, curr_max + x)
        max_so_far = max(max_so_far, curr_max)
    print(max_so_far)
